# Obsidian Cup

> Obsidian Cup organises volleyball and futsal tournaments in Bangladesh, for players from every corner of the country and at every level.

Tournament news is posted first on Instagram: @obsidian.volleyball and @obsidian.futsal. Dates, venues and fees for a coming season are final only once they appear there or on this site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/): what is coming next and recent champions
- [Volleyball](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/volleyball.html): the volleyball tournaments
- [Futsal](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/futsal.html): the futsal tournaments
- [Past seasons](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/tournaments.html): results and champions of earlier seasons
- [Fixtures](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/fixtures.html): schedules and results while a tournament is running
- [Register](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/register.html): how teams register when a season opens
- [Rules](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/rules.html): tournament rules
- [Questions](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/faq.html): common questions
- [About](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/about.html): who runs Obsidian Cup and why
- [Player stories](https://obsidiancup.vercel.app/pages/experiences.html): players on their experience
